name: Aluminium 6061-T6
notes: The general-purpose structural aluminium: machines cleanly, anodises well, and is stiff enough that a 6 mm bracket usually beats a 20 mm printed one. Design for the tool, not the shape you want: internal corners need a radius of at least half the pocket depth's worth of tool clearance (3 mm end mill => 1.5 mm minimum internal radius), pockets deeper than about 4x the tool diameter chatter, and thin webs below roughly 1 mm distort. Tapped M3 threads want 4.5-6 mm of engagement; through-bolting with clearance holes plus nuts is more forgiving than tapping thin plate.
cost_hint: mid-high; plate offcuts are the cheap route
